name: 0000_school_animal
articleContent: I see a little kitten and a rabbit. The hamster is cute. Look at the bird and the goldfish. They can fly and swim.

name: 0000_School_family
articleContent: This is my family. I love my Brother. I love my father. I love my mother. I love my sister.

name: 0000_school_first day
articleContent: It is my first day. I have a book and a crayon in my school bag. I have a pencil. I see a girl and a boy.

name: 0000_school_food
articleContent: I like to eat rice and meat. I eat vegetables and noodles. I drink soup. I like sandwiches.

name: 0000_school_number
articleContent: Let us count. One, two, three, four, five! Six, seven, eight, nine, ten! Good job.

name: 0000_school_occupation
articleContent: The postman brings letters. The doctor and nurse help people. The driver drives the bus. The street cleaner cleans the street. Put the can and paper in the bin.

name: 0000_school_public transport
articleContent: I go to school by bus. I can take a taxi or a train. The school bus is yellow. The ferry goes on water.

name: 0000_school_weather
articleContent: Look at the sky. It is sunny today. It can be windy or cloudy. Sometimes it is rainy.

name: 0100_HKUGAP_lesson_1
articleContent: Happy birthday! Get well soon! I have a Robot and a Teddy. I play with a Boat and a Computer. I bounce the Ball. I drive the Car.

name: 0100_HKUGAP_lesson_2
words: I go to school by bus.
A bus is stopping at the bus stop.
My father is a bus driver.
The bus is full of passengers.
articleContent: I go to school by bus. A bus is stopping at the bus stop. My father is a bus driver. The bus is full of passengers. I use my Octopus card to get on. I tap the card. We queue up. The bus driver is nice. We wait at the bus stop and get off.

name: 英文大挑戰（一）
articleTitle: Let's read: 英文大挑戰（一）
articleContent: The cow, bird, duck, and fish are animals. I see one, two, three, four, five cars. I see a taxi and a ship. The car is big. The taxi is small. The tree is tall. The grass is short. I see red, blue, green, and yellow. I use my eyes, ears, nose, and mouth. I love my mother, father, sister, and brother.

name: 英文大挑戰（二）
articleTitle: Let's read: 英文大挑戰（二）
articleContent: I have a pet. It is a dog, a cat, or a rabbit. Look at the sky and sun. Sometimes there is rain and cloud. Count to six, seven, eight, nine, ten! The colors are pink, white, and brown. I eat, play, write, and sleep. I use a pen and pencil. I write my name at school. I pack my bag. I sit on a chair at the table to do my homework.

name: actions
articleContent: I push and pull the door. I carry my bag. I turn on the light. I open and close the book. I play and move around.

name: activities
articleContent: We play bowling and go cycling. I like flying a kite and hiking. I go swimming. I play basketball and like dancing. I try horse riding and play football.

name: adjective 1
articleContent: The tree is tall. The boy is short. The snake is long. The elephant is big. The ant is small. The book is thick. The paper is thin. The rock is heavy. The feather is light. This is the opposite.

name: adjective 2
articleContent: I am happy. Sometimes I am sad or angry. I am scared of the dark. I am shy to meet people. I am glad to see you. I am worried. I am excited to play. I am surprised.

name: animal in zoo
articleContent: At the zoo, I see a fox and a peacok. I see a horse and a wolf. Look at the polar bear and leopard. The penguin is funny. The kangaroo jumps. The squirrel is fast.

name: animals
articleContent: The hen lays an egg. The cow gives milk. The pig is pink. The dog barks. The duck swims. The goat eats grass. The goose is white. The horse runs. The sheep is soft.

name: colours
articleContent: The sun is golden. The sky is blue. The pig is pink. The cat is black. The glass is transparent. The leaf is green. The flower is purple. The cloud is grey. The moon is silver.

name: daily commodity
articleContent: I look in the mirror. I wash with soap. I use a toothbrush and comb. I wash my hair with shampoo. I dry with a towel. The toy needs a battery. I use an umbrella in the rain. I wipe with a tissue.

name: do things in family
articleTitle: Let's read: Do Things In Family
articleContent: I do a craft and a puzzle. I enjoy reading and colour the book. We play a game and watch a movie. I like magic. We watch a show. We play hide and seek.

name: family
articleContent: My brother and sister play with me. My father and mother love me. My grandfather and grandmother read to me. My cousin, uncle, and aunt visit us.

name: feeling expressions
articleContent: I feel happy today. Do not be sad or angry. Are you scared or shy? I am glad. Do not be worried. I am excited. Are you surprised?

name: food 1
articleContent: I eat fried rice and pizza. I like a sandwich and spaghetti. I try sushi and bread. For dessert, I want a noodle and dim sum.

name: fruit
articleContent: I eat a pear and grapes. I like mango and banana. The pineapple is sweet. The strawberry is red. The star fruit is yellow. I eat an apple and watermelon.

name: greeting 1
articleContent: We say congratulations! We say happy new year! We say happy easter! We say happy mother's day! We say merry christmas! We say happy birthday!

name: greeting 2
articleContent: We say good bye and thank you. We say good afternoon and sorry. We say good morning. Could you please help me? May I play? Good night. You are welcome.

name: head
articleContent: This is my head. I have an eye and an ear. I have hair and a nose. On my head, I have a lip and a mouth. This is my face and my chin.

name: housework
articleContent: We wash clothes and set the table. We dust the furniture and iron clothes. We make the bed and sweep the floor. We wash dishes, mop the floor, and tidy up the toys.

name: occupation 1
articleContent: The postman brings mail. The policeman helps people. The driver drives the bus. The fireman stops the fire. The pilot flies a plane. The chef cooks food. The nurse and doctor help the sick. The teacher teaches.

name: occupations 2
articleContent: The engineer builds things. The actor and actress are on TV. The architect draws houses. The scientist does experiments. The accountant counts money. The security guard keeps us safe. The farmer grows food. The lecturer and lawyer talk a lot.

name: questions
articleContent: What is this? Why are you sad? When is it? Where is the dog? Who are you? How are you? Whose book is this? How much is it? Which one do you like?

name: season and time
articleContent: In the morning, I wake up. At noon and afternoon, I play. At night and midnight, I sleep. The seasons are spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

name: shapes
articleContent: This is a square and an oval. I draw a pentagon and a rectangle. I draw a heart, a triangle, and a circle. Look at the star and the diamond.

name: tableware
articleContent: I use a knife and chopsticks. I drink from a cup. I use a fork and a dish. I have a soup bowl and a spoon. Mom uses a teapot. I use a napkin.

name: things to do
articleContent: I sleep and wash face. I wash hands and eat. I change clothes and brush teeth. I sit, exercise, and take bath.

name: vegetables
articleContent: I eat potato and cabbage. I like broccoli and bean. I eat cucumber and tomato. I eat spinach, onion, and pumpkin.

name: words about school
articleContent: My classmate is nice. The teacher and principal are kind. We play on the playground at school. I sit in the classroom. I do my homework. We gather in the hall. The teacher writes on the blackboard.
